name: sous
description: Tools for checking what coding agents do: a Bash guard and zero-test check, red/green CI for skills, and a re-check of cited sources.

plugins.name: sous
plugins.description: sous-guard PreToolUse hook, the test-audit skill and tests-ran. Run `sous install` for permissions, sandbox and ask gates.

plugins.name: litmus
plugins.description: Red/green CI for skills and prompts. A green only counts if it could have failed.

plugins.name: verify-before-ship
plugins.description: Re-fetches every cited source and flags claims whose words, numbers or names are not on the page.
